units.source_text: 古歌：“我母预期我披，自幼不抚我黑发。”

en.t: An old poem says, "My mother foresaw that I would one day wear the robe; from childhood she did not stroke my black hair."

units.source_text: 是素性法师剃度时他的父亲遍照僧正所咏的歌。

en.t: This is the poem composed by his father, Bishop Henjo, when the monk Sosei took the tonsure.
It is found in the Gosen Wakashu.
